name: Galactic Council
description: Once enough empires have met, they found a galactic council: a yearly motion (sanctions, resource embargoes, war condemnations, lifting sanctions, recognising new states, declaring threats) is put to the vote; outvoted members drift into blocs that can split the council in two. Package 19d8 of the Emergent Galaxy set; everything else is the faithful game.

flags.name: galacticCouncil
flags.label: Galactic council
flags.description: A council of empires votes sanctions and embargoes each year; blocs form among the outvoted.
